claude_lead: The pet already sees your Claude Code sessions by reading your conversations. With the hooks, it also knows right away when a session asks you for permission.
hooks_note: Only Notch Pet's entries are touched; your other hooks stay as they are. Before writing, a copy is saved to settings.json.notch-pet.bak. If a session that was already open doesn't send alerts, restart it.
write_from_notch: Writing to a session from the notch
write_from_notch_note: It uses the claude command on your computer. If sending says it isn't logged in, open a terminal, run claude and type /login. What you do from the notch stays in the conversation, but if you have it open in the Claude app you won't see it until you reopen it.
